Perks › Epic

The Long Charge

Epic perk · Scoring bonus

Each non-scoring play banks a charge. Your next scoring play with an open-end total of 5 gains 5 points per charge.

In-game card text

How it works

Every one of your plays that does not score banks one charge for each copy. Your next play whose open ends add up to exactly 5 gains +5 points per banked charge, and the bank empties.

  • Plays that score 10, 15 or more neither add to nor spend the bank.
  • Any play with a total of exactly 5 empties the bank, even if Five Jinx wipes the points.
  • The bank resets at the start of every hand.

Worked example

With one copy you make three plays that don't score, then hit a total of 5: 5 + 15 = 20. With Five Alive as well it would be 25.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
